tools.name: find_store
tools.description: Find online stores in Brazil that sell on DMCommerce, by store name or by what they sell (e.g. "jeans", "suplementos", "acessórios 4x4"). Leave query empty to list every store. Returns up to 20 stores with their website and main categories.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search products for sale in DMCommerce stores (Brazil), across every store or in one store. Returns up to 10 products with price in BRL, whether it is in stock, the store and the product link.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get one product of a DMCommerce store: description, every option (size, color...) with its price in BRL and whether it is available, and the link that opens that option on the store website.

tools.name: quote_shipping
tools.description: Quote shipping for a product option to a Brazilian postal code (CEP), with the same options and prices the store checkout shows: carrier, price in BRL and delivery time in business days. Nothing is reserved or bought.

tools.name: get_store_info
tools.description: Contact (e-mail, phone, WhatsApp, address, hours), payment methods with installments and Pix discount, minimum order, shipping methods and free shipping rule, store benefits, FAQ, first purchase offer and the list of policy pages (exchanges, privacy, delivery) of one DMCommerce store.

tools.name: read_store_page
tools.description: Text of one page of the store: exchanges and returns, privacy, delivery, about us.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Category tree of one store, with the id of each category.

tools.name: browse_products
tools.description: Products of one store like the store website lists them: by category, tag or brand, with size/color filters, price range in BRL, only in stock, only on sale or featured, sorted by newest, price, best sellers or ending offers. The first page also brings the filters available (sizes, colors, brands, c

tools.name: get_category
tools.description: One category of the store: description, image, subcategories and the campaign (dates, whether it is still open) when it has one. Products come from browse_products with the same id.

tools.name: list_banners
tools.description: What the store highlights on its home page now: banner title, subtitle, button text, link and end date (campaigns, launches, sales).

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Free days and times of a bookable service (appointment, class, visit): duration in minutes, then the next 7 days with free slots and the seats left. Needs the bookable_option id from get_product; the booking itself is done on the store website.

tools.name: list_product_reviews
tools.description: Published customer reviews of one product (rating 1 to 5, comment, verified buyer, store reply), newest first, 20 per page.

tools.name: list_product_questions
tools.description: Questions other customers asked on the product page and the store answers (empty when the store does not use Q&A).

tools.name: get_related_products
tools.description: Products the store shows with this one: related items and the "buy together" suggestions.

tools.name: get_size_chart
tools.description: Size chart (measurements per size) the store shows for this product, to help the person choose the size.

tools.name: list_promotions
tools.description: Promotions running now in the store (free shipping rule, buy X pay Y, combo discounts, gifts), with the rule in words and the end date.

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.description: Articles published on the store blog, newest first, 10 per page.

tools.name: read_blog_post
tools.description: Text of one store blog article and the products it mentions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_product_reviews, list_blog_posts, read_blog_post · Private data: get_store_info · Public sink: read_blog_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_product_reviews, list_blog_posts, read_blog_post · Private data: get_store_info · Public sink: read_blog_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
